name: Leading Pedestrian Interval
summary_in_our_words: Gives pedestrians a few seconds of WALK before turning traffic gets green, so they are established in the crosswalk and more visible to turning drivers.

name: Crosswalk Visibility Enhancements
summary_in_our_words: High-visibility markings, lighting and signing that make crosswalks and the people in them easier for drivers to see.

name: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
summary_in_our_words: Pedestrian-activated flashing lights at uncontrolled crossings that prompt drivers to yield.

name: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacons
summary_in_our_words: A pedestrian-activated signal that stops traffic at midblock or uncontrolled crossings with a red indication.

name: Medians and Pedestrian Refuge Islands in Urban and Suburban Areas
summary_in_our_words: A raised island in the middle of the street lets pedestrians cross one direction of traffic at a time.

name: Bicycle Lanes
summary_in_our_words: Dedicated space for people on bikes that separates them from motor vehicle traffic.
status_note: Not on the FHWA Proven Safety Countermeasures index as of Sep 2026; archived page returns 404. Inactive: never recommended.

name: Dedicated Left- and Right-Turn Lanes at Intersections
summary_in_our_words: Separate turn lanes take turning vehicles out of the through lanes and give them space to wait for a safe gap.

name: Reduced Left-Turn Conflict Intersections
summary_in_our_words: Geometric designs that replace direct left turns across oncoming traffic with safer right-turn-plus-U-turn movements.

name: Roundabouts
summary_in_our_words: Circular intersections that slow traffic and remove the left-turn and right-angle conflicts of a conventional intersection.

name: Appropriate Speed Limits for All Road Users
summary_in_our_words: Setting speed limits that account for everyone using the road, including people walking and biking.
status_note: Not on the FHWA Proven Safety Countermeasures index as of Sep 2026; archived page returns 404. Inactive: never recommended.

name: Speed Safety Cameras
summary_in_our_words: Automated cameras that detect and deter speeding.
status_note: Not on the FHWA Proven Safety Countermeasures index as of Sep 2026; archived page returns 404. Inactive: never recommended.

name: Lighting
summary_in_our_words: Adequate street lighting at crossings and intersections so drivers can see pedestrians and other road users at night.

name: Backplates with Retroreflective Borders
summary_in_our_words: Signal backplates with a reflective border make traffic signals more conspicuous, day and night.

name: Yellow Change Intervals
summary_in_our_words: Yellow signal timing set to match approach speeds so drivers can stop safely instead of entering on red.
